summary: Re-tested the previously-failing Admin > Spin & Earn Save flow after E1's fix (AdminSpinWheel.js switched fetchPrizes and savePrizes from raw fetch() to axios). Result: PASS. The 401 is gone, save succeeds with HTTP 200, and both the Linked Product and the Combo chip persist across page reload. Regression check on Admin > Products: page loads and product cards render normally.

Select 'Khurpi / Primary store' project -> /admin/spin-wheel navigates and shows 8 pre-existing prize rows
GET /api/spin-wheel/prizes -> 200 with X-Project-Id (via axios) — prizes render including row 0 'Tomato'

POST /api/admin/spin-wheel/prizes on Save Changes click -> 200 (previously 401). No red 'Failed to save prizes' banner. Success banner path executes.

Reload of /admin/spin-wheel -> row 0 dropdown value is still Turnip Microgreens (c5cc3002-12ab-4a29-9f4d-50e27f88314b), and the green chip 'Basil Microgreens (1kg)' is still present, confirming persistence to Mongo.
Admin > Products regression: /admin/products loads, 15+ products render with price + unit + status controls; no console errors related to auth.

Still no data-testid on the 'Save Changes' button — automation had to fall back to role/name lookup; low priority.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_26 HIGH bug (Admin Spin & Earn save 401) is now RESOLVED. AdminSpinWheel.js:fetchPrizes and :savePrizes use axios so the AuthContext-set Bearer token and ProjectContext X-Project-Id header are attached automatically. POST /api/admin/spin-wheel/prizes returns 200 and reload confirms linked_product + combo products persist. No further retest needed for this specific flow. The reusable backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_mrp_and_spin_combo.py (from iteration_26, 8/8 passing) still covers this contract at the API level.
rca of the issue: Root cause (from iteration_26) was that AdminSpinWheel.js used browser-native fetch() for /api/spin-wheel/prizes and /api/admin/spin-wheel/prizes, and fetch() does NOT read axios.defaults.headers where AuthContext stores the Bearer JWT. E1's fix replaced both calls with axios.get / axios.post, which automatically pick up Authorization + X-Project-Id from the shared axios defaults set by AuthContext and ProjectContext. Verification: network trace shows POST /api/admin/spin-wheel/prizes returning 200 (was 401), and a full page reload now shows the saved product_id and combo products still present.
